edges.reason: Gradient descent in machine learning minimizes a loss objective, so the loss being optimized must be understood first.
Backpropagation applies the chain rule through the computation structure represented by a computational graph.
Backpropagation produces gradients used for parameter updates, commonly within gradient-based optimization.
